cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(CrealityVendor LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
add_compile_options(-fsigned-char)

find_package(Boost 1.83 REQUIRED)
add_library(boost_headeronly INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(boost_headeronly INTERFACE ${Boost_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_compile_definitions(boost_headeronly INTERFACE BOOST_LOG_DYN_LINK BOOST_ALLOW_DEPRECATED_HEADERS)
if(APPLE)
    target_compile_definitions(boost_headeronly INTERFACE BOOST_ASIO_DISABLE_KQUEUE)
endif()
if(CREALITY_COMPONENT STREQUAL "vendor")
    find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED)
    find_package(TBB REQUIRED)
    add_library(tbb_libs INTERFACE)
    target_link_libraries(tbb_libs INTERFACE TBB::tbb TBB::tbbmalloc)
    include_directories(SYSTEM ${EIGEN3_INCLUDE_DIR})
endif()

# Use bundled qhull to supply the qhull interface linked by libslic3r
set(CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_Qhull TRUE)

# ADMesh uses Slic3r's STL and locale headers; ImGuizmo uses the bundled ImGui
set(LIBDIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
include_directories("${LIBDIR}")
add_subdirectory(src/build-utils)
include(cmake/CrealityComponents.cmake)
foreach(directory IN LISTS creality_${CREALITY_COMPONENT}_directories)
    add_subdirectory("src/${directory}")
endforeach()
creality_export_components()
